sources.title: camembert-ner: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview camembert-ner is a French named entity recognition model fine-tuned from CamemBERT on the WikiNER-FR dataset, trained on approximately 170,634 sentences. Developed by Jean-Baptiste, this token classification model identifies five entity types: persons (PER), organizations (ORG), locations (LOC), miscellaneous entities (MISC), and non-entities (O). sources.title: Fine-tuned model for named entity recognition - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project present a notebook to create a fined-tuned Camembert model for named entity recognition. It applys also the Distillation method to keep a maximum of performance, while reducing it's size by 50%. this notebook use the labeled dataset of wikineural.
